caseNameFull: August A. Busch v. G. P. Webb

opinions.text: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Texas. April 27, 1904. Dismissed with costs, on authority of counsel for appellants. Mr. A. G. Moseley and Mr. Louis B. Eppstein for appellants. Mr. Amos L. Beaty for appellees.
